semiconductor_relevance: Medium — while PASSION Industrial Technology provides components and services relevant to semiconductor factories, its primary focus appears to be on fluid control and related technologies rather than direct semiconductor manufacturing or materials.
summary: PASSION Industrial Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. specializes in high-purity and special fluid control solutions, serving various industries including semiconductor factories. The company is committed to delivering high-quality and efficient solutions tailored to the unique needs of its customers.

regional_presence.China: PASSION Industrial Technology is based in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and serves the Greater China region.
